Review cached history, forecast age and saved monitoring settings.
Disease risk is not assessed here. No active alerts does not establish that the vineyard is safe.
Changing the unit does not convert the entered number.
Saving changed coordinates or time zone resets calculated risk progress and invalidates previous active alerts. Farm records and historical weather remain stored.
Blank means unknown. Decimal dot or comma; no grouping separators.
Search city or zone, e.g. Sofia
Online map: OpenFreeMap receives the viewed area and normal network information. Records stay local. No device location permission is used.
Pan and zoom until the crosshair is on your vineyard. For a missing/offline map, cancel and use manual coordinates.
Country and locality remain editable in the form. This basemap does not return a reliable address or nearest village.
Time-zone lookup sends this selected point only when requested. It is optional; coordinates can be used without it.
No blocks yet. Add a block to record its variety, measurements and planting details.
Related records will also be deleted. This cannot be undone.
Save to keep changes. Back discards unsaved changes. Leave optional measurements and planting date blank when unknown.
Optional; one dot or comma decimal separator; no thousands grouping
Optional; one dot or comma decimal separator
Use YYYY-MM-DD. Saving on an existing date updates that entry. Clearing the field keeps saved history.
No stage is inferred from planting age. Unknown units never imply metres or hectares.
Choose a vineyard to view its activity notebook.
Create a vineyard in the Vineyards tab first.
No activities match this view. Add one or change the status filter.
This deletes the activity and any structured spray record/product lines. This cannot be undone. Activities linked to a disease observation cannot be deleted.
Basic notebook entry. Detailed spray application records are not available in this form. Save to keep changes; Back discards unsaved changes.
Required only for Completed; clear it for other statuses.
Leave stage unknown when unobserved. Planned is the target date; completion is when the work was done and may be earlier. Keep both dates accurate.
This records what was applied. It does not recommend products/doses or confirm legal approval. Saving does not change activity status or completion date.
Prior single-product fields remain unchanged in Activity details. They are not automatically copied here; their water/rate units may be unknown.
Save to keep changes. Back discards unsaved changes. Quantities may be unknown; a known quantity requires its unit. Product lines describe one application, not a recommended tank mix.
Initially uses the vineyard time zone; choose the zone that applied to this application. Unknown local time remains blank; no UTC instant is inferred.
Changing a unit only relabels the number. No conversion, dose-rate calculation or label check is performed. Export uses saved records only.
This removes the structured application and all its product lines. The activity, its prior treatment fields and disease links remain. This cannot be undone.
Enter all four parts, or leave them all blank. No denominator of one is assumed and no dose is recommended.

Includes application date/local time/zone, area/carrier water, products, recorded rate/basis, references and notes. Old single-product activity fields are excluded and their presence is flagged. This is not a backup, label recommendation or compliant reporting template.

Files are plaintext. Choose a local folder for offline output; the system may also offer cloud providers. JSON preserves exact strings. CSV prefixes formula-like text for spreadsheet viewing; spreadsheet/re-save behavior varies.
CSV has one row per product. Application fields repeat on each row: do not sum repeated area or water values. Use UTF-8/comma delimiter and decimal dots when importing.
One saved application; product lines: %1$d. Export reloads saved data; unsaved edits are not included.
Saved one spray application; product lines: %1$d.
There is no saved spray application to export.
Export interrupted. Check the destination before retrying.
No harvest records yet. Record a harvest for this block.
No records for the selected season. Choose All seasons to see every record.
Quantities are shown in their recorded units. No total combines different units.
This harvest record will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
Save to keep changes. Back discards unsaved changes. Leave Brix blank when it was not measured.
Positive amount; one dot or comma decimal separator; no thousands grouping
Optional measured value, 0–100; blank means not recorded
Changing the unit only changes its label; it does not convert the number. Existing other unit labels are retained. Zero Brix is a recorded value, not an alias for unknown.
Includes vineyard/block names, local record IDs, season, dates, quantities, units and Brix status. Unknown Brix stays unknown; different units are not totalled.
Files are not encrypted. Choose a local folder for an offline copy; your system may also offer cloud storage providers. This exports harvest records, not an app backup or regulatory report.
CSV uses comma-separated columns, UTF-8 and decimal dots. Formula-like text receives a visible protective prefix; spreadsheet apps differ. Use JSON when exact text matters.
No records to export in this scope.
Records currently in this scope: %1$d. Saving reloads the records; the file is a snapshot at generation time.
Resolution is dated today in the vineyard’s time zone.
Only active observations are included in active disease summaries.
The activity will remain in the activity notebook.
This permanently removes the observation, its symptoms, and its activity links. The activities stay in the activity notebook.
No observations for built-in diseases in this block.
Enter the date you saw the symptom on the vine.
There are no unlinked completed activities with a completion date in this block.
Powdery patch on berries or cluster stems
White growth under a leaf lesion
The disease catalogue could not be loaded.
Reference signs can overlap with other problems. Use them to guide inspection.
Soft brown patches can develop before ripening. Affected shoots may wilt or break.
Affected berries may turn brown or reddish and develop a gray, velvety coating.
Check the area beneath a lesion for fine white growth.
Look for yellow patches with an oily appearance. Older lesions can be angular and stop at the veins.
White powdery patches may spread over berries or cluster stems. Older berry patches can leave dark, web-like scars.
Pale spots can appear on the upper surface. Check the underside for fine white growth that can become powdery.
Fungal disease of grapevines affecting leaves, shoots, and berries.
Favorable temperatures and susceptible vine growth
Monitor susceptible growth, improve canopy management, and follow locally approved disease-control recommendations.
Disease affecting grapevine leaves and fruit, particularly under wet conditions.
Spores dispersed by wind and water
Rainfall, leaf wetness, and favorable temperatures
Monitor infection conditions, manage canopy humidity, and follow locally approved disease-control recommendations.
Fungal disease that can cause decay of grape clusters.
Fungal spores and infected plant material
Humidity, moisture, damaged berries, and dense clusters
Improve airflow, minimize berry damage, and follow locally approved disease-control recommendations.

Log out and return to login
Logging out returns to login. Your local account and saved vineyard records stay on this device. Unsaved edits are discarded.
This permanently deletes your account and its local vineyard data. This action cannot be undone.
Some screens and error messages are still being translated.
Inactivity lock is optional and off by default. Your account password is always available when locked.
Biometrics are unavailable or not enrolled. Password unlock still works.
Uses your device PIN, pattern, password or passcode. On iOS, the system may also offer biometrics. No separate app PIN is stored.
Configure a screen lock in device settings to enable this option.
Turning inactivity lock off also turns both optional unlock methods off. Turning it on again starts with password unlock.

Source: Open-Meteo · modeled weather, not a vineyard sensor measurement.
Only weather attributed to this saved location is shown. Older unattributed/previous-location cache rows are retained but excluded; refresh to obtain current-location data.
Cached records are available offline. A refresh needs internet and sends the vineyard coordinates and time zone to Open-Meteo.
A failed refresh alone does not establish whether the device is offline. Previously saved data remains visible.
No completed refresh is recorded for this location yet.
A saved unfinished attempt is not proof that a request is still running. Coverage is cached evidence, not a disease safety assessment.
Coverage is the stored part of the last seven elapsed days, not proof of a complete disease-model input window.
